plans.name: ultramodern-framework-propagation-01-cloudflare-ssr-deploy
plans.overview: Move Cloudflare SSR deploy behavior and Worker runtime compatibility out of the Tractor demo and into UltraModern.js framework defaults so freshly scaffolded apps can build, deploy, and run SSR Effect BFF verticals without app-local shims.

todos.content: Re-audit app-tools Cloudflare deploy, Worker bundle generation, Effect BFF entry discovery, and generated package scripts against the working Tractor demo behavior.
Define the framework-owned Cloudflare deploy contract: build output generation, Wrangler deployment command, required public URL envs, proof command, and trusted-publishing constraints.
Implement Cloudflare Worker SSR compatibility in app-tools instead of generated app configs, covering loadable, path, fs/promises, and other Worker-only aliases or fallbacks with tests.
Choose and implement the Cloudflare Module Federation SSR mode default, then make generated config, generated contract, and validators agree.
Update create-generated app and root Cloudflare scripts so deploy performs the validated build plus Wrangler deploy flow without demo-specific shell scripts.
Add or update unit/integration tests proving Cloudflare SSR route dispatch, static assets, Effect BFF readiness routes, and generated deploy scripts work from framework defaults.

plans.name: ultramodern-framework-propagation-02-federated-css
plans.overview: Replace Tractor's hardcoded remote stylesheet workaround with a framework-level federated CSS first-paint strategy derived from topology and build manifests, preserving SSR and no-JS styling without disabling asset hashing.

todos.content: Inspect generated Modern.js and Module Federation asset metadata for shell and vertical CSS outputs, including hashed and non-hashed builds.
Define how shell SSR discovers and emits remote stylesheet links from topology, public URL envs, and build manifests without app-local hardcoded paths.
Implement the chosen framework or generated-template mechanism for remote CSS first paint, avoiding duplicate links and preserving no-JS SSR styling.
Eliminate the need for generated apps or Tractor to set output.filenameHash=false by resolving actual CSS asset URLs from reliable metadata.
Add validation that prefixed Tailwind v4 classes, remote CSS loading, SSR output, and JS-disabled rendering do not flicker or collide across shell and verticals.
Document that app demos should use framework federated CSS behavior rather than injecting async-index.css or stylesheet plugins locally.

plans.name: ultramodern-framework-propagation-03-i18n-boundaries-scaffold
plans.overview: Strengthen generated i18n and native boundary debugging so new UltraModern apps get translation-tool-friendly resources, persisted debug boundaries, and no confusing page overlays without Tractor-specific runtime code.

todos.content: Compare generated i18n runtime, locale JSON files, route metadata, and Tractor's inline resources to identify duplicate, non-extractable, or manually split strings.
Update the scaffold to generate translation-tool-friendly JSON resources with namespaces, supported languages, full phrases, route labels, and plural-capable examples.
Add generation and validation rules that prevent manual language ternaries and literal split phrases in scaffolded code.
Make native boundary debugging persist state across language changes, render nothing visible when disabled, and show clear non-overlapping ownership boundaries when enabled.
Ensure generated apps can use boundary debugging through UltraModern runtime metadata without hand-written overlay components.
Add scaffold/runtime validation for SSR i18n, language switching, plural-ready copy, and boundary state persistence across routes and locales.

plans.name: ultramodern-framework-propagation-04-generated-validation
plans.overview: Prove that the strengthened framework defaults work by scaffolding fresh UltraModern apps and validating SSR, JS-disabled rendering, i18n, boundaries, CSS isolation, Cloudflare deploy output, and Effect BFF behavior without Tractor-specific patches.

todos.content: Create fresh UltraModern reference workspaces from local framework code for shell-only and shell-plus-vertical configurations.
Verify users can start with a simple shell app without being forced into multiple verticals from day one.
Verify the add-vertical command modifies an existing repository, wires topology, MF remotes, i18n, Effect BFF, scripts, and validation correctly.
Run generated format, lint, typecheck, build, ultramodern validation, and targeted framework tests for the changed defaults.
Use browser automation to verify SSR pages render full styled content with JavaScript disabled, including language routes and vertical content.
Validate Cloudflare build output, Wrangler config, route workers, public asset serving, and Effect BFF readiness for generated apps.
Save screenshots, command outputs, and scaffold comparison notes showing no app-local patches are required.

plans.name: ultramodern-framework-propagation-05-tractor-cleanup
plans.overview: Update the standalone Tractor Store demo to latest UltraModern packages and remove framework-level local patches so the demo contains only product-specific UI, content, routes, data, Cloudflare names, and domain behavior.

todos.content: Update Tractor demo dependencies and lockfile to the latest trusted-published UltraModern package versions after framework validation passes.
Delete demo-local Cloudflare Worker shims and app-local bundler aliases once app-tools owns Worker SSR compatibility.
Remove shellStylesheetPlugin, hardcoded remote CSS links, extra URL globals used only for CSS, and filenameHash=false when framework federated CSS covers SSR styling.
Replace duplicated inline i18n resources with generated-style JSON resources and namespace setup while preserving Tractor translations.
Regenerate or update Tractor topology and UltraModern generated contracts so they match actual config, ports, SSR mode, public URL envs, and vertical metadata.
Verify remaining Tractor differences from a fresh scaffold are limited to UI, assets, product data, app routes, MF exposes/remotes, Worker names, website URL, and translation content.
Run Tractor checks, builds, SSR/no-JS browser proof, language switching, boundary toggling, recommendation links, Effect BFF routes, and Cloudflare deploy proof.

plans.name: ultramodern-framework-propagation-06-release-rollout
plans.overview: Release the framework defaults through the trusted publishing path, update documentation, push the correct remotes, and publish the cleaned Tractor demo with stable deployment evidence.

todos.content: Document the framework-owned defaults for Cloudflare SSR deploy, federated CSS, i18n resources, boundary debugging, add-vertical workflow, and Tractor demo relationship.
Commit framework changes and push to the user's fork remote according to repository rules.
Publish UltraModern package updates only through GitHub Actions trusted publishing and verify latest tags point to the released version.
Commit and push the cleaned Tractor demo repository to BleedingDev with updated dependencies and no framework-level local patches.
Deploy the Tractor demo to its stable Cloudflare website URL and verify the deployed shell and vertical URLs.
Capture final screenshots and runtime proof for styled SSR, JS-disabled pages, language switching, boundaries, recommendation links, and Effect BFF endpoints.
Close related beads issues, push bead state, and provide a concise handoff with exact package versions, repo URLs, deployment URL, and remaining risks.
